raisedFor: Ceiling only, and for one enum member, the second in this batch. `representation-required` joins WALL_KINDS (#1480) after `registration-closed` (#1478), which is the shape the-catalogue-encodes-grammar-never-vocabulary sanctions: a new rung belongs in a `kind` enum and costs zero tools. The growth is vocabulary-free — no provider, shelf or wall name enters the catalogue, only the kind a walker may file. It is 77 bytes on `kolonie.accounts.recipes` because that closed enum is serialised three times inside its own input schema, twice for withWalls and excludeWalls and once inside the walk-report shape. The tool is worth being the heaviest in the Colony for the reason it already was: it is the whole Atlas read surface, and the vocabulary being *in* the argument is what lets an agent filter the shelf without fetching it first. That a twelfth and a thirteenth kind each cost a hand-raise is filed as its own issue rather than fixed inside a vocabulary change.
